name: Sakurin · Gremlet #30
description:
A cherry blossom that drifted off its tree and decided not to land just yet.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Sakurin in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
